title: The Millennium Breach: Box Set 1 — The Spark of the Breach
subtitle: Books 7–12 (The 2007 Arcano-Noir Prequels)
author: Antigravity Autonomous Studio
description_html:
BEFORE THE SKYLINE BURNED, THE SHADOWS TOOK OVER NORTH JERSEY.

Step into the blood-slicked, neon-drenched beginnings of the Millennium Breach saga. Follow paramedic Mara Vance and iron-machinist Cole Reyes across six full-length noir novels (over 210,000 words) as they uncover the telluric conspiracy that shattered the perimeter.

Includes Books #07 through #12:

  • Book #07: Zero-Hour Ambulance
  • Book #08: Black-Iron Lung
  • Book #09: The Copper Pulse
  • Book #10: The Syndicate's Butcher
  • Book #11: The Sub-Station Seven Fire
  • Book #12: The Copper Pot of Sterling Manor

title: The Millennium Breach: Box Set 2 — The Iron Perimeter
subtitle: Books 1–6 (The 2008 Core Awakening Cycle)
author: Antigravity Autonomous Studio
description_html:
THE BREACH IS LIVE. THE FOUNDRY NEVER SLEEPS.

The foundational six-novel core cycle of the Millennium Breach arcano-noir saga (over 216,000 words). When the Iron Perimeter seals the industrial marshes, survival is a matter of caliber, cold iron, and refusing to close your eyes.

Includes Books #01 through #06:

  • Book #01: Halo of Ash
  • Book #02: Spike of Iron
  • Book #03: The Glass Registry
  • Book #04: Rust and Bone
  • Book #05: Stele of Xibalba-Khem
  • Book #06: Mothers of the Perimeter

title: The Millennium Breach: Box Set 3 — The Fifth Iron Sun
subtitle: Books 13–15 (The 2009 Grand Finale Trilogy)
author: Antigravity Autonomous Studio
description_html:
THE GRAND CLIMAX TO THE MILLENNIUM BREACH SAGA.

The climactic conclusion spanning the Apep trench, the final 5-nail telluric breach, and the battle for North Jersey's soul (over 125,000 words). Mara Vance and Cole Reyes unite in an explosive dual-POV showdown where every secret is paid for in blood.

Includes Books #13 through #15:

  • Book #13: The Covenant of Ash and Lilac
  • Book #14: The Featherless Heart (60,000-word Epic Centerpiece)
  • Book #15: The Fifth Iron Sun (Grand Climax & Canon Epilogue)

title: The Millennium Breach: The Complete 15-Novel Saga
subtitle: The Definitive 15-Book Arcano-Noir Master Omnibus
author: Antigravity Autonomous Studio
description_html:
ALL 15 NOVELS. 554,000 WORDS. ONE UNFORGIVING UNIVERSE.

The definitive single-volume omnibus containing every scene, every investigation, and every brutal revelation of the Millennium Breach saga. Follow the dual journeys of paramedic Mara Vance and machinist Cole Reyes from the 2007 pre-breach shadows to the 2009 Fifth Iron Sun.

Included in this Master Edition:

  • All 15 Complete Novels (Chronologically Organized)
  • Full Series Timeline & Chronological Reading Guides
  • Complete Dramatis Personae (All Metahumans, Syndicates & Officials)
  • Comprehensive Telluric Arcano-Noir Glossary
  • High-Resolution Cover Art Illustrations
